name: Do replacement windows increase home value?

mainEntity.name: Do replacement windows increase home value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacement windows can increase your home's value and appeal to potential buyers. New, energy-efficient windows are an attractive feature, as they offer long-term savings on utility bills and require less maintenance than older windows. They also enhance your home's curb appeal, making a strong first impression. The exact return on investment can vary based on the market and the quality of the windows installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, replacement windows can increase home value by improving curb appeal, energy efficiency, and offering long-term savings.
